decision_log.decision: Turn the dining table across the room (long axis along y) and use a built-in banquette on the north wall as the north head seat.
decision_log.rationale: A 2.20 m table along x plus two chair pull-outs needs about 5.00 m and would leave no living zone; across the room it needs 3.75 m, the banquette removes one pull-out, and eight seats fit (3+3 sides, 1 chair, 1 banquette place).

decision_log.decision: Mark the dining zone with a ceiling change (canopy dropped 0.15 m to 2.25 m over x 0.60-3.10 / y 1.30-4.50) rather than a level change.
decision_log.rationale: At 2.40 m there is no headroom to give up under a step and a platform would cut the end-to-end gallery; a shallow bulkhead marks the zone, carries the pendant and cove, and leaves the gallery and living zone at full height.

decision_log.decision: Place the hearth on the east end wall, centred on y 2.25, with the sofa facing it and its back forming the dining/living edge.
decision_log.rationale: Gives the room one axis from the entry door to the fire, lets the two zones share the length without any partition, and keeps the long south wall free for windows.

decision_log.decision: Run the circulation as a straight gallery along the south wall (centreline y 0.65) with no footprint south of y 1.15.
decision_log.rationale: Delivers a 1.15-1.31 m clear route from the west wall to the east wall, well over the 0.90 m minimum, and puts the walk past the windows rather than through the seating.

decision_log.decision: Put the entry door at the south end of the west wall (y 0.20-1.10), hinged on the south jamb.
decision_log.rationale: You enter at the head of the gallery looking down the room to the fire; the swing quadrant sits in the gallery where nothing stands and the leaf folds back towards the south wall.

decision_log.decision: Make the hearth wall asymmetric: full-height oak joinery on the north flank, a 0.80 m slot window on the south flank.
decision_log.rationale: Joinery on both flanks would block the east end of the gallery; a window there lets the route end on daylight and lights the hearth from the side.

decision_log.decision: Keep every wall and ceiling finish matt (mineral paint, lime plaster, emulsion); no mirrored panels and no gloss lacquer anywhere.
decision_log.rationale: Meets the materials exclusions and suits the low ceiling, where glossy or mirrored surfaces would read as glare.

decision_log.decision: Size the rug to 1.80 x 2.20 m so it stops 0.08 m short of the hearth slab and ends flush with the sofa's south arm.
decision_log.rationale: Keeps textile away from the fire while letting the sofa front legs and coffee table sit on it; the rug does not enter the gallery.

decision_log.decision: Leave 20 mm gaps between abutting footprints (chairs to table, banquette to table, hearth to breast, joinery to breast).
decision_log.rationale: Keeps every footprint distinct for the overlap check while matching how the pieces are actually built (shadow gaps and movement joints).

conflicts.constraint: Clear circulation path of at least 0.90 m from one end wall to the other.
conflicts.resolution: The south head chair (F09) backs onto the gallery. Its footprint leaves 1.31 m clear; drawn out 0.40 m for sitting it still leaves 0.91 m, so the minimum holds in use as well as on plan.
